cohort: 13,688 pregnant Omani women who gave birth to 104,281 babies at Sultan Qaboos University Hospital between January 1, 2005, and December 31, 2017.
finding: The prevalence of HIV in pregnant Omani women was 0.1%, and strict implementations on preventing MTCT were effective, with a 0% MTCT rate observed in infants born to mothers with known HIV who followed prevention programs.
gest_age: Mean gestational age of 39.67 weeks in infants born to mothers with unknown HIV status and 37.4 weeks in infants born to mothers with known HIV.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight of 3.2 kg in infants born to mothers with unknown HIV status and 2.6 kg in infants born to mothers with known HIV.
